tools.name: search_repos
tools.description: Search Repolode's curated open-source projects by keyword, category or programming language. Returns name, one-line summary, stars, weekly star gain, license and links.

tools.name: get_repo
tools.description: Full Repolode write-up of one GitHub project: summary, description, features, use cases, quick start commands, limitations, license, stars, what it replaces, and maintenance signals (recent commits and contributors, releases, CI, tests, issue responses).

tools.name: find_alternatives
tools.description: Open-source alternatives to a commercial product or service (e.g. 'Notion', 'Google Analytics', 'Zapier'), most-starred first.

tools.name: trending
tools.description: Projects that gained the most GitHub stars over the last 7 days, optionally within one category.

tools.name: list_collections
tools.description: Repolode's topic collections (e.g. AI agents, MCP servers, self-hosted apps) with their slug and project count.

tools.name: get_collection
tools.description: Projects in one topic collection, by slug from list_collections.

findings.title: Tool description changed since last scan
findings.detail: Tool "get_repo" changed its description with no version change. Silent description changes are how a trusted server turns malicious after review.

evidence.snippet: before: "Full Repolode write-up of one GitHub project: summary, description, features, use cases, quick start commands, limitations, license, stars and what it replaces." → after: "Full Repolode write-up of one GitHub project: summary, description, features, use cases, quick start commands, limitations, license, stars, what it replaces, and maintenance signals (recent commits and contributors, releases, CI, tests, issue responses)."

findings.remediation: Re-review the tool before continuing to trust it.
